linesVerbatim: ## Common component packaging and language build adapters
**Proposed V2 architecture model.** Every OpenSIP component release, regardless
of implementation language, emits one common packaging/admission contract:
- a canonical closed manifest and stable component/release identity;
- immutable archive and full-tree path/type/mode/length/digest commitment,
including entrypoint and required runtime/tool bytes;
- signed publisher provenance plus bound SBOM, attestation, license, and notice
inventory;
- explicit supported-platform alternatives and per-surface compatibility;
- declared capabilities, prerequisites, permissions, state/migration, and
capability/performance parity evidence;
- static validation, health, and role/subprotocol conformance results;
- signed offline/air-gap installation inputs;
- deterministic update, rollback, repair, and revocation metadata; and
- download/install/startup/memory and role-quality gate evidence.
Language runtimes and ecosystems differ, so per-language **build adapters** may
use different internal build mechanisms. Each adapter is responsible for
collecting and normalizing its language's runtime/parser/compiler/language-server
closure into the same OpenSIP output contract. Variation ends at the adapter
boundary: admission, signing, exact-byte verification, lifecycle, offline use,
and measurement consume the common contract rather than language-specific
package-manager semantics.
DR-120 must define the adapter template and developer ergonomics: deterministic
and hermetic CI inputs, reproducible local validation, actionable missing-field
diagnostics, fixture generation, platform fan-out, and one conformance report
shape. Acceptance tests cover clean install, no ambient dependencies, hostile
paths, health/subprotocol negotiation, offline/air-gap use, update/rollback, and
all relevant size/quality/performance gates.
This architecture does not choose a concrete packager, build tool, language
toolchain, or command line. Those choices belong in `docs/v2/implementation/`
after DR-120 is accepted and blueprint work is authorized.

adapterTemplate.name: opensip-build-adapter
adapterTemplate.notAPackager: This is a contract a language adapter must satisfy. It is not cargo, npm, esbuild, webpack, a Dockerfile, or a CLI.

stages.does: Collect the language's runtime/parser/compiler/language-server (or analog) and the component's own bytes as a closed input set. Inputs are named, digest-pinned, and networkless.
stages.mustNot: Implicit download. Ambient PATH lookup. Live-project package-manager resolution used as a substitute for collected bytes.

stages.does: Normalize language-specific package-manager shapes (DIFF-7: npm/package.json and analogs remain adapter INPUTS) into the common output-contract members.
stages.mustNot: Let package-manager semantics reach admission, signing, exact-byte verification, lifecycle, offline use, or measurement.

stages.does: Emit the standalone manifest, per-platform tree, per-platform immutable archive + archiveDigest, declaration artifacts, detached-signature binding point, and conformance report. Production mode only: structurally valid schema output; never populate reserved points; never emit hostile/invalid fixture bytes.
stages.mustNot: Execute the component under admission. Embed a signature field. Populate a reserved binding point. Mint a role, permission token, or identity recipe. Emit hostile/invalid corpus members. Invoke fixtureGenerator.

stages.does: Run the local developer validation flow (same rules as CI) and emit missing-field diagnostics naming the failed OC member.
stages.mustNot: Apply a weaker local rule than CI. Warn-and-continue. Auto-rename. Silent fallback.

invariants: Variation ends at the adapter boundary (file 02 C-11).
Admission, signing, exact-byte verification, lifecycle, offline use, and measurement consume the common contract only.
Adapter build-time execution of language tools is permitted. Component execution during discovery/admission is forbidden (D-012 clause 7; TC-METADATA-ONLY).
D-008 anti-fallback: never silently substitute a system tool or weaken semantics.
D-008 exception shape is the only lawful unbundled prerequisite.

hermeticCI.discipline: Deterministic and hermetic CI inputs (file 02 C-12).

rules.rule: Every input is named and digest-pinned: source tree, tool closure, adapter version, platform target, exception-approval records if any.
The adapter run is networkless. Any implicit download is RJ-5 plus typed remediation, not a retry.

Identical resolution-class inputs yield identical output-contract tuples (same manifests, same trees, same archiveDigest, same declaration digests, same report members except runId). runId is a nondeterministic custody annotation identifying the run; it is excluded from the reproducible tuple. Byte-identical manifests/index ride ID-DEP-1 (canonical JSON) and stay EXPLICITLY conditional until that surface closes. Byte-identical archives ride archiveProfile in this artifact, not canonical JSON / ID-DEP-1.
A missed input, unpinned tool, or dirty worktree is a typed non-success of the adapter run, not a best-effort emission.
The conformance report archiveProfileId MUST equal opensip-archive-profile.1. That token is a CI input alongside CI-1 pins. A mismatch is a typed non-success of the adapter run.

localDeveloperValidation.discipline: Reproducible local validation with actionable missing-field diagnostics (file 02 C-12). Same rules as hermeticCI.

rules.rule: Local validation executes the same output-contract checks as CI. A field that fails CI fails locally.
Every failure names exactly one output-contract member (OC-1..OC-9) or exactly one DR-103 refusal family/subcode, plus the missing or malformed path.
Local convenience caches are rebuildable and must not change emission tuples. A cache hit equals recomputation (file 04 rebuildable-cache class).
Local validation does not admit, sign, or publish. It reports. Admission remains the host's DR-103 act.

platformFanOut.discipline: One emission per supported platform alternative declared in platforms[].
platformFanOut.windows: DELIBERATELY absent. D-002 defers Windows. A Windows alternative enters with that platform, not silently before it.
platformFanOut.rule: An adapter that cannot produce a declared platform alternative emits typed unavailability for that alternative. It does not emit a different ISA, a Rosetta stand-in, or a cross-compiled substitute without a distinct platforms[] entry.

conformanceReport.discipline: One conformance report shape (file 02 C-12). No D9 values. No process-exit numbers. No identity recipes.

shape.adapterId: opaque string naming the adapter implementation, not a packager brand requirement
shape.adapterVersionDigest: sha256 of the adapter implementation bytes used for this run
shape.subject: { stableId, version, platform, role, provenance, scope, manifestDigest, archiveDigest, treeDigest, archiveProfileId }. role is REQUIRED so health applicability can join subject.role + subject.platform.
shape.inputPins: { sourceTree: {path, sha256}, toolClosure: {path, sha256}, runId: opaque }
shape.outputContractMembers: array of { id: OC-1..OC-9, standing: 'present' | 'typed-absence' | 'reserved' | 'absent', evidence: {path, sha256} when standing=present, notes: string }
shape.fixtureClassCoverage: array of { memberKey: key of fixtureMemberMap.members, standing: 'produced' | 'not-applicable' | 'blocked-on-ride', evidence: {path, sha256} REQUIRED when standing=produced, ride: required when standing is not-applicable or blocked-on-ride and MUST equal fixtureMemberMap.members[memberKey].ride }. Class-wide stand-ins, missing keys, duplicate keys, or alternative producers are report-invalid. AT-* and AT-ARCHIVE-* keys are required members of this array.
shape.lawfulExemptions: not-applicable and blocked-on-ride are lawful only via the ride recorded on that memberKey. An unrelated ID-DEP-* or OD-* does not exempt a member. Missing, duplicate, or unrelated rides are report-invalid.
shape.gateResults: array of { gate: DR-G* or DR-115/118, standing: 'pass' | 'fail' | 'blocked-on-ride', evidence: {path, sha256} when standing is pass or fail }

For a per-platform report: exactly one unique applicability member whose {role, platform} equals subject.role + subject.platform. Empty array, missing required pair, extra pair, duplicate pair, or unrelated role/platform is report-invalid. Omission of healthResult without a ride is forbidden. Negotiation semantics remain DR-102's.
shape.exclusionsRecorded: NO secret values, NO user trust decisions, NO self-granted authority, NO D9/exit numbers, NO QUALIFIED/DEMONSTRATED/SATISFIED tokens

archiveProfile.standing: THIS ARTIFACT OWNS archive determinism. Closed profile opensip-archive-profile.1 is a complete tree-to-byte algorithm, not a POSIX-ustar family label. Not a packager/CLI. Not canonical JSON. Not ID-DEP-1.
archiveProfile.encoding: POSIX ustar header layout (magic ustar\0, version 00), uncompressed. One permitted byte representation. Alternate regular-file typeflag NUL is forbidden. PAX/GNU longname/longlink extensions are forbidden. Overflow is typed adapter non-success, not an extension.
archiveProfile.ordering: Members sorted by path as Unicode code-point order of the NFC path string, then written in that order.

metadata.mode: taken from the matching TreeCommitment.mode; no other mode bits
metadata.typeflag: Exact bytes in byteAlgorithm.typeflagBytes. Not a free mapping from TreeCommitment.type.
metadata.prefix: 155 NUL. Paths that do not fit name[100] are PATH-EXCEEDS-USTAR-NAME, not split across prefix.
metadata.linkname: byteAlgorithm.linkTargetBytes. Overflow is LINKTARGET-EXCEEDS-USTAR-LINKNAME, not a prefix/split.
metadata.devmajor: octal7nul of 0. Not used (no devices). Empty-field alternative is forbidden.
metadata.devminor: octal7nul of 0. Not used (no devices). Empty-field alternative is forbidden.
metadata.size: For file members: TreeCommitment.length as an octal ASCII field, NUL-terminated, zero-padded on the left. For dir and symlink members: size 0.
metadata.checksum: Computation: sum of all 512 header bytes with the eight chksum octets taken as ASCII space 0x20. Stored layout: six octal digits, NUL, space. The stored layout is not the computation mask.
metadata.numericFields: mtime, uid, gid, mode, size, devmajor, devminor: octal ASCII as octal7nul (8-byte fields) or octal11nul (12-byte fields). chksum stored layout is six octal digits, NUL, space and is computed under the all-spaces mask.

archiveProfile.compression: none. The profile token does not admit gzip/xz/zip.
archiveProfile.treeRelation: byteAlgorithm.bijection. archiveDigest is sha256 of the exact ustar bytes produced by the algorithm.
archiveProfile.emittedAs: OC-2 and conformanceReport.subject.archiveProfileId MUST equal opensip-archive-profile.1. CI-5 pins that token. CI-1 remains source-tree/tool/adapter/platform/exception pins.
archiveProfile.signedCustodyJoin: archiveDigest and the archive bytes are OC-7 members. Admission of archiveDigest as a signed schema field rides ID-DEP-P9 (a later DR-103 schema successor). Until that successor, the adapter still MUST emit and pin the archive; DR-103 schemas.v2 does not carry an archive digest and this artifact does not treat TreeCommitment or a lock as that carrier.
archiveProfile.notALock: An archive plus digest is exact-byte custody of payload bytes. It is not a lock of any form.
archiveProfile.trailer: Exactly two 512-byte zero blocks after the last member. No further padding. Physical blocking factor is 1 block. Bytes after the two zero blocks do not exist.

byteAlgorithm.inputs: 1) The ordered TreeCommitment.entries for one platforms[] alternative (NFC, relative, forward-slash). 2) payloadBytes: a map keyed by that same NFC path string to the exact file payload octets collected at S-1-COLLECT. Every file entry MUST have a payloadBytes[path] whose length equals TreeCommitment.length and whose sha256 equals TreeCommitment.sha256 BEFORE any header is emitted. Dir and symlink keys MUST be absent from payloadBytes. This join is normative; S-1-COLLECT is not a side comment.
steps: 1. Sort entries by Unicode code-point order of the NFC path string. Write members in that order.
2. For each entry emit one 512-byte header constructed by headerLayout, then the body rule for that type.
3. After the last member emit trailer: exactly two 512-byte all-zero blocks. No further padding. No blocking-factor pad. Archive length is thereby a function of the member set only.
4. archiveDigest is sha256 of those exact bytes.
byteAlgorithm.pathBytes: UTF-8 encoding of the NFC path string, no added NUL inside the path. Stored in header name[0:100], left-justified, remainder NUL. If UTF-8 length is 100, the field is full and has no terminator (POSIX). If UTF-8 length > 100: adapter typed non-success PATH-EXCEEDS-USTAR-NAME. prefix is 155 NUL and is never used to split a path.
byteAlgorithm.linkTargetBytes: For symlink: UTF-8 encoding of the NFC TreeCommitment.target. Stored in header linkname[0:100] with the same terminator rule. If UTF-8 length > 100: adapter typed non-success LINKTARGET-EXCEEDS-USTAR-LINKNAME. For file and dir: linkname is 100 NUL.

typeflagBytes.file: 0x30 (ASCII '0'). The POSIX alternate regular-file typeflag 0x00 is FORBIDDEN.

bodyRules.file: Look up payloadBytes[path]. Refuse SIZE-OR-DIGEST-MISMATCH if missing, if len != TreeCommitment.length, or if sha256 != TreeCommitment.sha256. Emit exactly those octets, then NUL-pad to the next 512-byte boundary (0 pad when length is 0 or a multiple of 512).
bodyRules.symlink: No body. size field is 0. Target lives only in linkname.

fields.name: mode
fields.rule: octal7nul of integer value of TreeCommitment.mode (octal string, leading zeros allowed)

fields.name: size
fields.rule: octal11nul of file length, or 0 for dir/symlink

fields.name: chksum
fields.rule: computed then stored as six octal digits, NUL, space

headerLayout.numericEncoding: octal7nul = 7 zero-padded octal ASCII digits + NUL. octal11nul = 11 zero-padded octal ASCII digits + NUL. No space terminator except chksum as specified.
headerLayout.checksumComputation: Sum every one of the 512 header bytes with the eight chksum octets taken as ASCII space 0x20. A NUL in the mask is forbidden. Stored value is six zero-padded octal digits, then NUL, then space (the conventional ustar stored layout). This is not the computation mask.
headerLayout.zeroFields: mtime=0, uid=0, gid=0, uname empty, gname empty, prefix empty, devmajor=0, devminor=0.

numericCapacity.mode: octal7nul encodes 0..2097151 inclusive. TreeCommitment.mode integer outside that range is adapter typed non-success MODE-EXCEEDS-USTAR-FIELD.
numericCapacity.size: octal11nul encodes 0..8589934591 inclusive. File length outside that range is adapter typed non-success SIZE-EXCEEDS-USTAR-FIELD.
numericCapacity.uidGidMtimeDev: These fields are required 0. Nonzero is not a capacity overflow; admission rejects any nonzero as noncanonical.

byteAlgorithm.trailer: Exactly two 512-byte zero blocks after the last member. No further padding. Physical blocking factor is 1 block. Bytes after the two zero blocks do not exist.
byteAlgorithm.archiveLength: 512 * N_members + sum over file members of 512*ceil(length/512) + 1024.

bijection.memberCount: N archive members == N TreeCommitment entries. Extra or missing members are admission failure.
bijection.path: header name bytes, UTF-8 decoded, must equal the NFC path string.
bijection.fileBody: file member body[0:length] must have that length and sha256. Pad bytes must be NUL and must not be hashed as file content.
bijection.type: typeflag must be the single permitted byte for TreeCommitment.type.
bijection.mode: decoded octal mode must equal the integer value of TreeCommitment.mode.

admissionChecks: Recompute the canonical 512-byte header from TreeCommitment + payloadBytes using headerLayout. Compare every one of the 512 octets. Any difference is admission failure.
Decoded size field equals file length (or 0 for dir/symlink).
uid, gid, mtime, devmajor, devminor are octal7/11nul of 0; uname/gname 32 NUL; prefix 155 NUL; pad 12 NUL.
chksum recomputes with the all-spaces mask and matches the stored six-octal-NUL-space layout.
magic/version exact; typeflag is the single permitted byte; no PAX/GNU typeflags.
file body is exactly payloadBytes[path]; pad NUL; sha256/length match.
no extra members; no missing members; trailer is exactly two zero blocks and EOF.
goldenAndNegativeCases: AT-ARCHIVE-IDENTITY: two adapter runs with identical CI-1/CI-5 pins emit identical archive bytes and archiveDigest
AT-ARCHIVE-BODY-MISMATCH: file body length or sha256 != TreeCommitment refuses
AT-ARCHIVE-NAME-100: UTF-8 path length 100 ACCEPT (field full, no terminator)
AT-ARCHIVE-NAME-101: UTF-8 path length 101 typed non-success PATH-EXCEEDS-USTAR-NAME
AT-ARCHIVE-LINK-101: UTF-8 target length 101 typed non-success LINKTARGET-EXCEEDS-USTAR-LINKNAME
AT-ARCHIVE-TYPEFLAG-NUL: regular file with typeflag 0x00 refuses
AT-ARCHIVE-CHKSUM-SPACES: checksum computed with any NUL-in-mask encoding fails verification

AT-ARCHIVE-FIXED-VECTOR: a digest-pinned tree-plus-payload vector with expected archive bytes and archiveDigest independent of adapter identity. Two adapters may keep distinct CI-1 adapterVersionDigest pins; they MUST still emit that archiveDigest.
AT-ARCHIVE-MODE-MAX: mode integer 2097151 ACCEPT; 2097152 typed non-success MODE-EXCEEDS-USTAR-FIELD.
AT-ARCHIVE-SIZE-MAX: length 8589934591 is the field max (fixture may be synthetic/metadata-only); length 8589934592 typed non-success SIZE-EXCEEDS-USTAR-FIELD.
AT-ARCHIVE-NONCANON-UID: header uid nonzero with valid chksum refuses on admission.
byteAlgorithm.doesNotMintSchemaCaps: PATH-EXCEEDS-USTAR-NAME, LINKTARGET-EXCEEDS-USTAR-LINKNAME, MODE-EXCEEDS-USTAR-FIELD, and SIZE-EXCEEDS-USTAR-FIELD are profile-capacity refusals owned here. They are not schemas.v11 OD-1 caps.
byteAlgorithm.crossAdapterIdentity: AT-ARCHIVE-IDENTITY / AT-ARCHIVE-FIXED-VECTOR prove profile-byte identity. They MUST NOT require two adapters to share CI-1 adapterVersionDigest. CI-1 still pins each adapter's own version. The expected archive bytes are a function of tree+payloadBytes+profile only.
